title: LLM4POL run usage -- charter section 13 M3 (3), CONTEXT D-04, D-39, invariant A-3
description: usage.json of a run: the sums of the recorded evaluation costs. evals (an integer) and cpu_hours (a number) are two budget currencies that are counted apart and never merged into one number (charter section 4 A-3); tokens and usd are provider counts recorded from Phase 6 on and are 0 until then. All five keys are required and the object is closed, so a merged or extra currency is refused. This schema is self-contained (no cross-file reference) because the schema-inventory step validates without a registry. A change that a reported result depends on is a new schema version in a new file (charter section 4 A-5), never an edit of this one once results cite it.
